why_the_tokenizer_is_pinned_separately: a changed subword split changes every score at a fixed threshold while the weights stay byte-identical, so 'the same model' is not enough.
why_this_is_a_file: the trainer required a non-empty --model-revision and accepted whatever was typed, which pins the shape of the claim and not the claim. This file is committed, so the pin is pre-registration rather than a runtime argument.
